notes:
1.17.38 had been built and published but never merged, so no installed app could see it. This carries it, and what a check of it found.

DEBUG's helper line now says what it can establish: the press asks the helper's status, which looks for the running helper's own window. Found means running; not found means crashed or stopped, and it says which. It used to print “Running — your bindings are live” from the moment the helper was started, whether or not it was still there. The version shown is labelled exe=, because it is the version of the file on disk that answered.

The line under the Tax Check no longer claims a list the tool refused. A capture that was cut short, or whose caption carried no date, is named as not taken, with the reason; a capture file that could not be read says so instead of saying protel opened nothing.

The helper (v25) reads a list that was shown before it had rows. In v24 a report opened empty was read once and never asked for again; the request is now placed before anything can discard it.

“Already known” now means the ledger agreed with the report. A row the ledger refused while stating a different departure is counted as kept as the census had it. An empty room cell is a failed read, not a holding room, and every refusal of a report says why.

The release page on GitHub describes the release it belongs to; it had shown 1.17.14’s text since 1.17.14.
